release.scope: Release/debug build as invoked. Fixed 50,000 generated records; exact Foundation path-match semantics. Each query's scan/result time is measured; input creation, digest/equivalence validation and 10 ms simulated input-event pacing are excluded from query work. MainActor heartbeat is a headless scheduling probe, not SwiftUI frame or table-rendering measurement. Background timing includes detached dispatch/await. Cancellation trials may complete before cancellation, reported explicitly. No source image I/O, hashing, engine, cache, debounce, or full-app memory measurement.

legacyLazyChainDiagnostic.scope: Separate toolchain diagnostic of Array<Int>.lazy.filter.prefix traversal, not a measured filesystem path query.
legacyLazyChainDiagnostic.swiftSource: var calls = 0; let items = Array(0..<50_000); let matches = Array(items.lazy.filter { item in calls += 1; return item.isMultiple(of: 8) }.prefix(50_000)); print("input=\(items.count) matches=\(matches.count) predicateCalls=\(calls)")
